tagline: Ek chhota, fast VPN: ek round trip aur aap andar.
description: WireGuard ek modern VPN hai jo poore IP packets ko encrypted UDP datagrams ke andar daalta hai. Har side ek Curve25519 public key se pehchani jaati hai, handshake sirf ek round trip leta hai, aur sirf chaar message types hain. Jo server ki public key nahi jaanta, uske liye yeh bilkul chup rehta hai.

normal.name: Tunnel se office NAS tak pahunchna
normal.summary: Laptop office gateway se handshake karta hai, tunnel ke zariye NAS ko ping karta hai, aur tunnel ko zinda rakhta hai.

steps.title: Handshake Initiation
steps.detail: Laptop 10.20.0.5 ko packet bhejna chahta hai, jo uske AllowedIPs ke hisaab se office peer ka hai. Abhi koi session nahi hai, to woh pehle Handshake Initiation bhejta hai. Isme ek fresh ephemeral key, laptop ki identity (encrypted) aur ek encrypted timestamp hota hai, sab gateway ki known public key se protected.

quiz.q: Gateway ki public key ke bina koi random initiation bhejta hai. Gateway kya reply karta hai?
quiz.why: MAC1 gateway ki public key se keyed hota hai. Agar woh galat ho to WireGuard packet ko chupchaap drop kar deta hai, isliye port scans ko kuch nahi dikhta.

steps.title: Handshake Response
steps.desc: Type 2, 92 bytes: keys agree ho gayi
steps.detail: Gateway MAC1 check karta hai, laptop ki static key decrypt karke apni peer list mein dhoondta hai, aur check karta hai ki timestamp pichle wale se naya hai. Woh apni ephemeral key aur ek khaali encrypted message ke saath jawab deta hai. Ab dono sides chaar Diffie-Hellman results ko mix karke session keys ki ek jodi banate hain, har direction ke liye ek.

steps.title: Tunnel ke through ping
steps.desc: Type 4 asli IP packet carry karta hai
steps.detail: Laptop 10.20.0.5 ko apna ping (84 bytes) leta hai, use 96 tak pad karta hai, ChaCha20-Poly1305 se encrypt karta hai aur Transport Data message mein wrap karta hai. Gateway tag check karta hai, decrypt karta hai, check karta hai ki inner source is peer ke liye allowed hai, aur plain ping office LAN par bhej deta hai. NAS ko kabhi pata nahi chalta ki tunnel involved tha.

quiz.q: Inner packet 84 bytes ka hai. Use carry karne wala WireGuard message kitna bada hai?
quiz.why: 16-byte header, packet 96 bytes tak padded, aur 16-byte tag: 16 + 96 + 16 = 128.

steps.title: Keepalive
steps.desc: Har 25 s par ek 32-byte khaali packet
steps.detail: PersistentKeepalive = 25 ke saath, jab tunnel 25 seconds shaant rehta hai to laptop ek khaali Transport Data message bhejta hai. Isme koi inner packet nahi hota, sirf header aur tag. Yeh ghar ke router ka NAT mapping khula rakhta hai taaki gateway laptop tak pahunch sake.

quiz.q: Laptop ko keepalives kyun chahiye lekin gateway ko aam taur par nahi?
options: Gateway ke paas keys nahi hain
Laptop NAT ke peeche hai, jo idle mappings bhool jaata hai
quiz.why: Ghar ke routers idle UDP mappings ek-do minute baad drop kar dete hain. Keepalives ke bina gateway ke packets band darwaze se takrayenge.

steps.title: Har 2 minutes mein fresh keys
steps.detail: Session keys 120 seconds (ya 2^60 messages) ke baad badal di jaati hain. Laptop bas naya Handshake Initiation bhejta hai jabki purani keys chalti rehti hain, isliye traffic kabhi rukta nahi. Purani keys phenk di jaati hain, matlab baad mein chori hui key pehle ke traffic ko decrypt nahi kar sakti (forward secrecy).

outro.title: Ek round trip mein tunnel
outro.text: Asli packets chalne se pehle WireGuard ko sirf do handshake messages chahiye the. Phir har IP packet ek chhote UDP datagram ke andar 16-byte header aur 16-byte tag ke saath travel karta raha, aur keepalives ne NAT ka darwaza khula rakha.

cookie.name: Load ke under: cookie reply
cookie.summary: Initiations ki flood se gateway mehnge crypto se pehle address ka proof maangta hai.

steps.title: Initiations ki flood
steps.desc: Har ek gateway ka asli CPU kharch karta hai
steps.detail: Attacker jo gateway ki public key jaanta hai, forged addresses se hazaaron Handshake Initiations bhejta hai. Unka MAC1 valid hota hai, isliye gateway ko har ek ke liye mehnga Curve25519 maths karna padta. Yeh capture gateway par liya gaya hai.

steps.title: Response ke bajaye cookie
steps.desc: Type 3, 64 bytes: apna address prove karo
steps.detail: Load ke under gateway khaali MAC2 wale initiation ke liye mehnga kaam nahi karta. Woh uski jagah sasta Cookie Reply bhejta hai. Cookie sender ke IP aur port ka MAC hota hai, ek secret ke under jo har do minute mein badalta hai, isliye gateway kuch store nahi karta. Forged senders ko apni cookies kabhi nahi milti.

quiz.q: Forged source addresses wala attacker cookie kyun use nahi kar sakta?
options: Cookie forged address par jaati hai, attacker ko nahi
Cookies 1 ms mein expire ho jaati hain
Attacker ke paas VPN client nahi hai
quiz.why: Reply packet ke address par bheja jaata hai. Agar woh address fake hai, to attacker ko cookie kabhi nahi dikhti aur woh valid MAC2 nahi bana sakta.

steps.title: MAC2 ke saath retry
steps.desc: Address ka proof, phir normal handshake
steps.detail: Laptop cookie decrypt karta hai aur apne retry timer (5 seconds) ka intezaar karta hai. Uska agla initiation cookie se bana MAC2 carry karta hai. Gateway MAC2 sasta check karta hai, dekhta hai ki laptop sach mein us address par rehta hai, aur poora handshake karta hai. Forged floods kisi mehnge kaam se pehle hi drop ho jaate hain.

outro.title: Asli users nikal gaye
outro.text: WireGuard ka cookie reply TCP ke SYN cookies jaisa kaam karta hai: load ke under gateway CPU kharch karne se pehle sasta proof maangta hai ki sender apne address ka maalik hai. Forged floods ko cookie kabhi nahi milti, isliye woh jaldi drop ho jaate hain.
